text:
Maya R: hi team :wave: I'm in my first week and trying to find the engineering onboarding docs + the 'service-runbook' template. where do folks keep those in Notion? i can view some pages but not edit.
Sam G: hey maya! welcome :tada: engineering stuff lives under Notion > Spaces > Engineering > Playbooks. runbook template is at: https://notion.redwood.company/Engineering/Playbooks/Runbook-Template (read-only by default).
Maya R: thanks — i clicked the link but when i try to duplicate i get a permission error. what's the fastest way to get edit access for duplicates? :question:
Sam G: easiest is to ask Docs team to add you to the 'engineering-editors' group. ping @docs-admins or run the access request flow: `/request-docs-access engineering-editors` (Devex bot will route it).
Maya R: do i need to specify a page name in the request? or just the group?
Sam G: just the group. include your manager if you want faster approval. note: we ask that personal copies live under /People/<your-name>/ so ownership is clear.
Devex Bot: Access request received: `/request-docs-access engineering-editors` from Maya R at 1865432120. Please allow ~10-30m for approvals. If you need immediate edit rights, tag @jess.l.
Alex T: tiny tip — when you duplicate the runbook template, rename it to `teamname-runbook YYYY-MM` and add the tag `#runbook` so our search indexing surfaces it. also add a short summary at the top: 1-2 lines of what the runbook covers.
Maya R: great, i'll do that. also, where should onboarding checklists live? i saw two similar pages and wasn't sure which is canonical.
Jess L: canonical onboarding checklist is under Engineering > Onboarding > Starter Kits. the other one is an old team-specific checklist — you can flag it with a comment `@docs-admins is this deprecated?` and we'll archive if needed.
Maya R: perfect. last q: are there any team templates for infra runbooks specifically (cronjobs, incident steps)?
Sam G: yes — infra-runbook and cron-ops templates are in the same Playbooks folder. search for "infra-runbook" or filter by tag `#infra`. if you want, i can DM links.
Maya R: would appreciate that, thanks! :pray:
Alex T: FYI — if you're going to edit a shared playbook, please add a small changelog block at the bottom with date + your initials. saves a lot of follow-ups.
Jess L: and ping @docs-admins once you publish the page so we can add it to the team nav and the docs index.
Maya R: awesome — sending the request now. thanks everyone for the quick help :sparkles:
